item.title: Advisory Council
item.description: ◎Chen Deming, former Minister of Commerce, is CCG Honorary Chair. Long Yongtu, former Vice Minister of Commerce and form...
item.content:encoded:
◎Chen Deming, former Minister of Commerce, is CCG Honorary Chair. Long Yongtu, former Vice Minister of Commerce and former Secretary-General of Boao Forum for Asia, is CCG Chairman. He Yafei, former Vice Minister of Foreign Affairs and former Deputy Director of the Overseas Chinese Affairs Office of the State Council, and Ronnie Chan, Chairman of Hang Lung Properties, are the Co-Chairmen. A large number of renowned entrepreneurs serve as vice chairmen, council members and executive council members of CCG Advisory Council. In addition, many leaders from industry who are passionate about public issues join the CCG Series Forum as members to participate in CCG activities.

◎CCG Advisory Council currently includes over 100 business members with an international perspective. If you are interested in social welfare, think tank development, globalization, international relations, international economic and trade development and other international issues, and are willing to join the CCG Advisory Council / CCG Series Forum, please submit the following information and the CCG Council will get back to you.
